points: Yirmiyahu's own final chapter ends with the fall of Bavel: injustice will not have the last word.
Bavel is called a hammer: mighty, but only a tool in Hashem's hand. When its mission ends, so does its power.
Bavel is a golden cup that intoxicates: success went to its head and it did not humble itself before Hashem.
Its fall is sudden: Belshazzar falls the very night he uses the keilim of the Beis HaMikdash.
